verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The velocity half of (9.7) is literal: `totalVelocity` is componentwise (b+β, V+v, G+γ) + w, with the base triple from the Context, the mean triple (β,v,γ) and the oscillation w in the same radial/angular/axial order. The pressure half is split: a Lean `State` stores only the increment, so `totalPressureIncrement` is p_m + p_w and the fixed base pressure p_{B,*} is a separate summand `p₀` restored at the physical bridge, where the pressure handed to the Navier–Stokes residual is `p₀ y + s.totalPressureIncrement n y` = p_{B,*} + p_m + p_w. The two angular-mean conditions ⟨w⟩_θ = ⟨p_w⟩_θ = 0 are not fields of the same definition; they are the `oscillation_mean_zero` and `oscillatoryPressure_mean_zero` fields of `MeanHypotheses`, which the stage invariant carries (field `meanHypotheses` of `CycleAnalyticInvariant`), and `angularAverage` is the θ-average over [0, 2π] divided by 2π, i.e. ⟨·⟩_θ.
